author: Donna Wood-Dudley
text:
Medically, 
It can refer to 
"Immune &/or *idiopathic(*no known cause). Thrombocytopenia Purpura"...
a low platelet count that can cause problems in your clotting factor 
You can Easily bruise, experience gums bleed, random nose bleeds. Meds can attribute to it, as well as an immuno issue 
bone marrow produce your platelets & would suggest something is causing marrow not producing enough 
Usually it'll resolve on its own but, you'd be well advised to get checked out thru your PCP and get full blood panels done, possibly a consult with a haemotologist to rule out any underlying issues
